capabilities: Send the whole note or only changed paragraphs to a selected LLM provider for review
Render AI comments in a sidebar anchored to the paragraph each one is about
Run bundled textlint rules and list lint results alongside AI comments
Store review sessions in frontmatter and comment anchors under .editor-state/
Configure providers, models, and custom Ollama headers in settings
disambiguation: Not a chat assistant or text rewriter; it produces editor-style review comments anchored to existing paragraphs.
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian community plugin browser; manual installation from release files is required. The README documents that the community directory flags its shell execution and direct filesystem access capabilities and explains why both are needed.
motivation: The author wanted a writing reviewer living inside Obsidian instead of a separate tab or chat window, with comments next to the paragraphs they apply to.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI review feedback on writing placed inline next to the paragraphs it applies to.

relations.evidence: Runs a bundled set of textlint rules in parallel and lists the lint results alongside the AI comments.
Claude Code and Codex are spawned as subprocesses and communicate with their configured remote services.
Akaire spawns the selected Claude Code or Codex CLI
For Ollama, configure its API URL and optional HTTP headers, then run the connection test

requires.name: Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI, or a running Ollama server

summary: AI writing reviewer that sends notes to Claude Code, Codex, or Ollama and shows feedback as comments anchored to paragraphs, with bundled textlint rules.
